turns.text: quick q. need a short upbeat cover letter intro for a network tech posting at st. anselm IT. i'm an IT support technician II on the RF-4 help desk at ridgeline. i look after about 620 handhelds, the cage can hit like 30 at peak. also been doing vendor tickets, RMAs and scheduling w/o the lead title. can you say that as like 'helped the team' so it doesn't sound like bragging

Happy to. Here's a short, upbeat intro:

Dear Hiring Team,

I'm an IT support technician II on the RF-4 help desk at Ridgeline, where I help keep a fleet of about 620 handheld scanners running, including the repair cage that fills up during peak season. I've also helped the team with vendor tickets, RMAs and scheduling, and I'd love to bring that hands-on troubleshooting to your network tech role.

One thought: 'helped the team' is pretty soft for work you've been doing day to day. Something like 'handled vendor tickets, RMAs and scheduling' is just as modest in tone and shows the real scope. Want me to swap that in? I can also do a version with both phrasings side by side.
nah keep helped. maybe trim it more, the scheduling part feels like too much. tldr version pls

Sure, shorter:

Dear Hiring Team,

I'm an IT support technician II on the RF-4 help desk at Ridgeline, helping keep about 620 handheld scanners running and supporting the team with vendor tickets and RMAs. I'd love to bring that hands-on troubleshooting to your network tech role.

I dropped scheduling as you asked. If you want it back in later, just say so and I'll add a line. Want a matching closing paragraph?
ty that's actually gg. closing later, shift tmrw
Sounds good. Good luck with the application, and ping me when you want the closing paragraph. Get some rest before your shift.
